architecture.asn1: Ruby DER/BER codec, available on native and Wasm
architecture.crypto_tls: libcrypto/libssl provider through a bounded C adapter; Ruby objects own generation-checked typed handles; no host Ruby subprocesses

architecture.wasm: retain existing portable digest/HMAC/AES and ASN.1; explicit capability errors for provider-backed key/certificate/TLS operations, without unresolved imports
